export interface SkillAuthoredFields {
    name: string;
    description: string;
    when_not_to_use?: string;
    argument_hint?: string;
    applies_to: SkillAppliesTo;
    body: string;
}

export interface SkillAuthoredReadRequest {
    ref: SkillRef;
}

export interface SkillAuthoredRemoveRequest {
    scope: SkillScope;
    skill_id: string;
    expected_version: number;
}

export interface SkillAuthoredRemoveResult {
    skill_id: string;
    remaining: number;
}

export interface SkillAuthoredSaveResult extends SkillImportConfirmResult {
    skill_id: string;
    skill_version: number;
}

export interface SkillAuthoredSource extends SkillAuthoredFields {
    skill_id: string;
    version: number;
    scope: SkillScope;
    mine: boolean;
}

export type SkillAvailability = {
    available: true;
} | {
    available: false;
    reason: SkillUnavailableReason;
    detail?: string;
};

export interface SkillBodyReadRequest {
    refs: SkillRef[];
}

export type SkillBodyReadResult = {
    ref: SkillRef;
    ok: true;
    name: string;
    body: string;
} | {
    ref: SkillRef;
    ok: false;
    reason: SkillReadRefusal;
    detail?: string;
};

export interface SkillCase extends SkillCaseFields {
    case_id: string;
    origin: "conversation" | "person";
}

export interface SkillCaseFields {
    title: string;
    task: string;
    material?: string;
    expected: string;
}

export interface SkillCasePutRequest extends SkillCaseFields {
    draft_id: string;
    case_id?: string;
}

export interface SkillCaseRemoveRequest {
    draft_id: string;
    case_id: string;
}

export interface SkillCatalogEntry {
    ref: SkillRef;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    when_to_use?: string;
    when_not_to_use?: string;
    applies_to: SkillAppliesTo;
    user_invocable: boolean;
    argument_hint?: string;
    tools: string[];
    resources: SkillResourceSummary[];
    connector_categories: string[];
    runs_scripts: boolean;
    excerpt: string;
    pack: {
        plugin_id: string;
        title: string;
        version: string;
        publisher_label: string;
        trust: SkillPackTrust;
        scope: SkillScope;
    };
    state: SkillState;
    settings_revision: number;
    enabled?: {
        at: string;
        by: string;
        scope: SkillScope;
    };
    availability: SkillAvailability;
    last_used?: {
        at: string;
        caller: SkillPickConsumer;
        run_ref?: string;
    };
    recent_uses?: Readonly<Record<SkillPickConsumer, number>>;
    based_on?: {
        source: SkillSourceRef;
        newer_version?: number;
    };
    draft?: {
        draft_id: string;
    };
}

export interface SkillCatalogListRequest {
    applies_to?: string;
    states?: SkillState[];
}

export interface SkillDraft {
    draft_id: string;
    scope: SkillScope;
    target: SkillDraftTarget;
    fields: SkillAuthoredFields;
    revision: number;
    origin: SkillDraftOrigin;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
    cases: SkillCase[];
    trial?: SkillTrial;
    base?: {
        version: number;
        fields: SkillAuthoredFields;
    };
    replacements: Record<string, string>;
    untried: string[];
    trial_needed: boolean;
}

export interface SkillDraftAdoptRequest {
    draft_id: string;
    expected_revision: number;
    accept_differences?: boolean;
}

export interface SkillDraftAdoptResult extends SkillAuthoredSaveResult {
    source?: SkillSourceRef;
}

export interface SkillDraftCreateRequest {
    scope: SkillScope;
    target: SkillDraftCreateTarget;
    fields?: SkillAuthoredFields;
    case?: SkillCaseFields;
}

export type SkillDraftCreateTarget = {
    kind: "new";
} | {
    kind: "own";

    from_version?: number;

} | {
    kind: "custom";

};

}

export interface SkillDraftReviseRequest {

}

export interface SkillDraftSummary {
    draft_id: string;
    scope: SkillScope;
    target: SkillDraftTarget;

    revision: number;

    updated_at: string;
    verdict?: SkillTrialVerdict;

}

export type SkillDraftTarget = {
    kind: "new";
} | {
    kind: "own";
    skill_id: string;
    base_version: number;
    rebase?: SkillSourceRef;
} | {
    kind: "custom";

};

export interface SkillDraftUpdateRequest {

export interface SkillImportCandidate {
    skill_id: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    file_count: number;
    bytes: number;
    importable: boolean;
    applies_to?: SkillAppliesTo;
    applies_to_from?: "file" | "suggested";

    runs_scripts: boolean;
    change: "new" | "upgrade";
}

export interface SkillImportConfirmRequest {
    preview_id: string;

        skill_id: string;

}

export interface SkillImportConfirmResult {

    publisher_key_id: string;
}

export interface SkillImportPreview {
    preview_id: string;

        plugin_id: string;

        installed_version: string | null;

}

export interface SkillImportPreviewRequest {

}

export type SkillImportSource = {
    kind: "runtime";
    runtime_id: CharacterImportRuntimeId;
} | {
    kind: "project_directory";
    directory_id: string;
};

export interface SkillInstallPreview {
    skill_id: string;
    version: number;

export type SkillPackTrust = "host" | "pinned" | "home_local";

export interface SkillPick {

}

export type SkillPickConsumer = string;

export type SkillReadRefusal = (typeof SKILL_READ_REFUSALS)[number];

export interface SkillResourceContent {
    ref: SkillRef;
    path: string;
    role: SkillResourceRole;
    media_type: string;
    bytes: number;
    sha256: string;
    encoding: "utf8" | "base64";
    content: string;
}

export interface SkillResourceReadRequest {
    ref: SkillRef;
    path: string;
}

export interface SkillResourceSummary {
    path: string;
    role: SkillResourceRole;
    bytes: number;
}

export type SkillScope = (typeof SKILL_SCOPES)[number];

export interface SkillSettingsSetRequest {
    scope: SkillScope;
    install_id: string;
    skill_id: string;
    state: SkillState;
    expected_revision: number;
}

export interface SkillSourceRef {
    install_id: string;
    plugin_id: string;
    skill_id: string;

    name: string;
}

export type SkillState = (typeof SKILL_STATES)[number];

export interface SkillTrial {
    trial_id: string;
    draft_revision: number;
    case_id: string;
    ran_at: string;
    cells: SkillTrialCell[];
    verdict: SkillTrialVerdict;
}

export interface SkillTrialCell {
    consumer: SkillTrialConsumer;
    side: "base" | "draft";
    output: string;
    verdict: SkillTrialVerdict;
    differences: string[];
}

export type SkillTrialConsumer = string;

export interface SkillTrialRunRequest {
    draft_id: string;
    expected_revision: number;
    case_id: string;
}

export type SkillTrialVerdict = (typeof SKILL_TRIAL_VERDICTS)[number];

export type SkillUnavailableReason = (typeof SKILL_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS)[number];

export interface SkillVersion {
    version: number;
    fields: SkillAuthoredFields;
    adopted_at?: string;
}

export interface SkillVersionsListRequest {
    scope: SkillScope;
    skill_id: string;
}

export declare const isSkillPickConsumer: (value: unknown) => value is SkillPickConsumer;
